name: pixellab-ai-generator
description: Generate editable PixelLab PLP projects from text prompts. PSD/SVG import, JSON spec, 150-family font catalog.

interface.longDescription: Generate editable PixelLab PLP projects, inspect and validate files, search and recommend typefaces, synchronize Fontsource metadata, download Google Fonts TTF variants and import licensed custom TTF/OTF files.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable PixelLab PLP project from this design brief.
Inspect and validate this PixelLab PLP file.
Help me plan a layered PixelLab design before generating the PLP.
